el Poblenou — Barcelona, Spain

Relatively safer day Average night

In detail

No pattern of theft or violence against tourists was found for the core el Poblenou barri. Local coverage instead centers on squatting-related disorder: in November 2022 residents reported intimidation from an 'okupa mafia' subletting an illegally occupied building, and in October 2025 an occupied warehouse that had reportedly become the scene of constant beatings and street brawls among its occupants was evicted. These incidents involve occupants/local disputes rather than crime targeting visitors. Sources checked: COPE, 3 Nov 2022; Crónica Global, 3 Nov 2022; El Debate, 10 Oct 2025.

Frequently asked questions

Is el Poblenou safe?

Wandroz currently rates el Poblenou in Barcelona, Spain as relatively safer than most other areas covered on Wandroz during the day and roughly average compared to other areas covered on Wandroz at night. This is a qualitative first-pass assessment based on general local knowledge and public reputation, not an official geolocated crime dataset — see the note on data limitations below before treating it as more precise than it is.

At night, el Poblenou is rated as roughly average compared to other areas covered on Wandroz. If you're unsure, it's worth checking recent local reviews for your specific street or block, since a neighbourhood-wide rating can't capture block-by-block variation.
